_provenance.status_vocabulary: validation_status values are exactly the four CLAUDE.md §12.2 categories (here: Unresolved). No fifth category is introduced. Where the sources provide no basis for a role (ELTE), the status stays Unresolved and the disposition is carried by descriptive fields - source_disposition: 'absent_from_sources' and do_not_invent: true. A fifth status value would bypass both honesty gates (no_unresolved_material_claims fails only on 'unresolved'; W1 governs only 'assumed') and would be a de facto change to §12.2's vocabulary without an amendment (§14.1). See decision_log/status-vocabulary-correction_2026-07-13.json.
